name: Rostland Edge
source: Adventurer's Guide pg. 26, Inner Sea Combat pg. 56
body:
Source Adventurer's Guide pg. 26, Inner Sea Combat pg. 56
Aura moderate evocation and transmutation CL 10th
Slot none; Price 21,820 gp; Weight 3 lbs.
Description
Crafted to defend against enemies seeking to damage it rather than its wielder, a Rostland edge is a +2 counteringUE imperviousUE Aldori dueling sword. If the weapon is ever destroyed, it explodes with tremendous force, dealing 10d6 points of fire damage to every creature within a 20-foot-radius spread (Reflex DC 14 half).
Construction
Requirements Combat Reflexes, Craft Magic Arms and Armor, cat’s grace, fabricate, fireball, make whole; Price 11,070 gp
